label: Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 lives
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever has intellect lives (LIVING_1: operates from itself, timelessly). After ST I q.18 a.3, where understanding is the highest grade of life and life is grounded in intellect. Not identified with STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES or the route SelfOperationLife, which conclude LIVING_2 (life present at some time of a duration frame) from the absence of potency, nor with STMT-THINKER-LIVES (bearers of occurring thoughts).
